name: ZPVA NMR + EnGrad (M06-2X, pcSseg-2, DMSO)
template:

# REQUIRED: keep BOTH 'NMR' and 'EnGrad' on the keyword line (the node needs the
# shielding from the .out AND the analytic gradient from the .engrad), and an
# %eprnmr block selecting the nucleus you average. Edit method / basis / solvent /
# nucleus to taste; use the SAME level as the Frequencies job that made the .hess.

! M062X pcSseg-2 AUTOAUX RIJCOSX CPCM(DMSO) NMR EnGrad VeryTightSCF DEFGRID3

%maxcore 3000

%pal nprocs 8
end

!!##COORDS_SEC##!!

%eprnmr
   NUCLEI = ALL F { SHIFT }
END
